problems.description: Employees receive emails that appear to come from internal IT requesting credential updates. The messages contain malicious links that harvest login credentials when clicked.
risk_reduction: Enable multi‑factor authentication (MFA) for all user accounts
Deploy email filtering to flag or quarantine suspicious senders
Run regular security awareness training and phishing simulations

problems.description: A trusted employee copies sensitive customer data onto a personal USB drive and transfers it out of the corporate network.
risk_reduction: Implement strict USB/device usage policies with endpoint DLP
Monitor file access and data transfer logs for anomalies
Enforce least‑privilege access controls

problems.description: An attacker exploits a misconfigured service to gain administrative privileges on a critical server, allowing them to install backdoors and move laterally.
risk_reduction: Regularly audit and patch operating systems and services
Use role‑based access control and avoid running processes as root
Deploy intrusion detection systems (IDS) to catch unusual privilege use

problems.description: An S3 bucket containing customer PII is left publicly readable, exposing sensitive data to the internet.
risk_reduction: Enforce automated checks for public‑access settings
Use IAM policies to restrict bucket access to known roles
Enable bucket logging and review access logs regularly

problems.description: Hard‑coded API keys in a public GitHub repository allow attackers to access and manipulate cloud resources.
risk_reduction: Store secrets in a managed vault (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager)
Scan code repositories for leaked credentials
Rotate API keys on a regular schedule

problems.description: A vulnerable container image allows an attacker to break out of the container namespace and gain root access on the host.
risk_reduction: Use minimal, trusted base images and apply timely patches
Run containers with non‑root users and restricted capabilities
Deploy container runtime security tools to monitor system calls

problems.description: Students’ credentials for an educational platform are transmitted over unencrypted HTTP, risking interception by attackers.
risk_reduction: Enforce HTTPS/TLS for all web traffic
Implement strong password policies and MFA
Conduct regular penetration tests on the platform

problems.description: Unrestricted database permissions allow staff to view or export sensitive student grades and personal information without proper authorization.
risk_reduction: Apply role‑based permissions at the database level
Mask or redact PII in non‑production environments
Audit database access and alert on large exports

problems.description: An outdated educational software package with known vulnerabilities is still in use on campus machines, opening attackers to remote code execution risks.
risk_reduction: Maintain a centralized patch management process
Isolate legacy systems in a segmented network zone
Monitor vulnerability feeds and apply critical fixes promptly

problems.description: Targeted phishing attacks aimed at specific individuals within an organization, often using personal information to increase credibility.
risk_reduction: Educate employees on recognizing spear phishing attempts
Implement email authentication protocols like SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
Use threat intelligence to identify and block known phishing domains

problems.description: Phishing attacks that specifically target high-profile individuals such as executives, often involving highly personalized messages.
risk_reduction: Conduct regular training for executives on phishing awareness
Implement strict email verification processes for sensitive communications
Monitor for unusual login attempts from executive accounts

problems.description: Voice phishing attacks where attackers impersonate legitimate entities over the phone to extract sensitive information.
risk_reduction: Train employees to verify identities before sharing sensitive information
Implement call-back verification procedures for sensitive requests
Use caller ID verification technologies to identify spoofed calls
